# Visible power pin-tip contact

Built with Copperpour's served `create_project`, `add_schematic_component`,
and `add_power_symbol` tools using stock `Device:R` and `power:GND`. Saved
by KiCad 10.0.8 with `kicad-cli sch upgrade --force`.

`#PWR01.1` touches `R30.1` at `(124.46, 137.16)`. The GND pin has no pin-level
hide flag. The visibility of the `#PWR01` reference field is independent.
